title: Learning Proposition-Level Links from Sentence-Level Supervision for Neuro-Symbolic NLI
abstract: arXiv:2610.15158v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study neuro-symbolic natural language inference (NLI) with independently translated propositional representations of the premise and hypothesis. Before symbolic reasoning, the system must infer semantic links between their proposition-level units (atoms). Existing systems based on Abstract Meaning Representation (AMR) and Boolean satisfiability (SAT) identify these links using fixed embedding-based source selection and pretrained sentence-level NLI models not trained for atom-level linking. We introduce a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type. Without atom-pair training annotations, we treat cross-formula link structures as latent and train the linker from sentence-level NLI labels, keeping the translator and SAT reasoner fixed. translated_title: 从句子级监督中学习命题级链接以实现神经符号自然语言推理
translated_abstract: 我们研究了使用前提和假设的独立翻译命题表示的神经符号自然语言推理（NLI）。在符号推理之前，系统必须推断其命题级单元（原子）之间的语义链接。现有的基于抽象含义表示（AMR）和布尔可满足性（SAT）的系统使用固定的基于嵌入的源选择方法以及未针对原子级链接训练的预训练句子级NLI模型来识别这些链接。我们引入了一个可训练的原子链接器，它可以联合预测链接的存在性、源选择和关系类型。在缺乏原子对训练标注的情况下，我们将跨公式链接结构视为潜在变量，并从句子级NLI标签来训练该链接器，同时保持翻译器和SAT推理器固定不变。我们在斯坦福自然语言推理（SNLI）和涉及组合知识的句子（SICK）的完整公开测试集上进行评估。
tldr: 该论文提出一种可训练的原子链接器，无需原子对标注，通过将跨公式链接结构视为潜在变量并仅从句子级NLI标签进行训练，即可联合预测命题间链接的存在性、源选择和关系类型，从而提升神经符号自然语言推理系统的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a trainable atom linker that jointly predicts link existence, source selection, and relation type without atom-pair annotations, by treating cross-formula link structures as latent variables and training solely from sentence-level NLI labels, thereby improving neuro-symbolic NLI systems.
